reasons: Deviation classification is correct: the cap basis (3% of bill-of-materials value of Products delivered across the entire term) is materially below the fallback's 12 months' fees — over a multi-year term it equates to only a single-digit percentage of one year's purchase value — and the clause contains no carve-outs at all, so indemnities and confidentiality breaches sit inside a very low cap (the rule's walk-away scenario).

The redline is targeted and directionally right: it preserves the existing mutual lead-in ('total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action…'), replaces only the illusory basis with the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and adds one carve-out sentence covering indemnification, confidentiality/data security, IP infringement, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud plus the payment-obligations clarification. The 0.872 changed-character ratio reflects a rule-mandated basis replacement, not scope creep.
Mutuality is retained and the mutual consequential-damages waiver in p0273 is left untouched, so the edit does not over-reach or disturb terms that already benefit us.

Comment is accurate, in-voice and prefixed: it states what changed, why (3% of BOM is below our 12-month minimum), notes indemnities/confidentiality sit outside the cap, and offers the straight 12-months'-fees fallback.
